field.description: The specific organization field to retrieve. Valid values: name, displayName, desc, url, website.
field.title: Field

name: get_member_invited_org

GetMemberInvitedOrgResponse.description:
Response schema for `GetMemberInvitedOrg`.

This endpoint returns the raw value of the requested organization field directly from the API.
The response type varies depending on which field is requested:
- String fields: name, displayName, desc, url, website, logoHash, logoUrl, idEnterprise, offering, dateLastActivity
- Boolean fields: invited, enterpriseOwned
- Integer/Number fields: billableMemberCount, activeMembershipCount, membershipCount
- Array fields: idBoards, memberships, premiumFeatures, products, powerUps, invitations
- Object fields: prefs, descData, limits

field_value.description: The raw value of the requested organization field. Type varies by field: strings (name, displayName, desc, url, website, logoHash, logoUrl, dateLastActivity), booleans (invited), integers (billableMemberCount, activeMembershipCount), arrays (idBoards, memberships, premiumFeatures, products, powerUps), objects (prefs, descData, limits).
field_value.title: Field Value
